sql: SELECT TOP 10 ua.UserId AS userId, MAX(CASE WHEN a.IsDefaultBilling = @isTrue THEN a.AddressId END) AS billingAddressId, CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN a.IsDefaultShipping = @isTrue THEN a.AddressId END) AS varchar(max)) AS shippingAddressId FROM dbo.ZnodeUserAddress ua INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeAddress a ON a.AddressId = ua.AddressId WHERE ua.UserId = @owner GROUP BY ua.UserId HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN a.IsDefaultBilling = @isTrue THEN a.AddressId END) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(CASE WHEN a.IsDefaultShipping = @isTrue THEN a.AddressId END) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ua.UserId
